## Remove(ListeningHost) {#Sisk_Core_Http_ListeningHostRepository_Remove_Sisk_Core_Http_ListeningHost_}

Try to remove a [ListeningHost](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Http.ListeningHost.md) from this repository. If the item is removed, this methods returns [`true`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp
public bool Remove(ListeningHost item)
```
